Baloch Activist Mahrang Baloch Sentenced to Life in Pakistan

Mahrang Baloch, a Nobel Peace Prize nominee known for advocating for missing persons in Pakistan's Balochistan province, has been sentenced to life in jail. This conviction has drawn criticism from human rights groups and sparked fears of increased unrest in the region. Critics suggest Pakistan is using its courts to silence peaceful Baloch voices, while others, including Greta Thunberg, have called for Baloch's freedom.
